# compress

compress(nums) sorts the distinct integers in nums and joins them with commas, writing every run of THREE OR MORE consecutive integers as first-last. Inside a range, a negative endpoint is written in parentheses; outside a range, numbers are written plainly. compress([]) == "".

Examples: compress([1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8]) == "1-3,5,7,8"; compress([-3, -2, -1, 4]) == "(-3)-(-1),4".
